_readme: Every check starts with passes:false and verdict:null. Only a verifier verdict changes passes/verdict/verified_by/evidence/verified_at/commit; the orchestrator transcribes the verifier report and cites it.

Makers never edit this file (it is listed in .mission/frozen-paths.txt). Adding checks is allowed at any time; removing or editing a check needs a D-entry and a different agent than the one failing it (stop rule S7).

type: executable (field command; run by .mission/check.sh <milestone>, exit 0 = the criterion holds) | rubric (field rubric; graded by a verifier with evidence) | live (PENDING-LIVE until the live run) | human (decision or sign-off from the human queue).
verdict: null | PASS | FAIL | UNVERIFIED. UNVERIFIED is never PASS; a required UNVERIFIED check keeps its gate PENDING.
requirements: >=1 requirement ID from requirements.yaml (conventions section 3). Replace the four example checks with the mission's checks; keep this _readme and the field names.

checks.description: <observable criterion, e.g. POST /outfits with a valid body returns 201 and the outfit is readable by id>
checks.command: <command run from the repository root that exits 0 only when the criterion holds, e.g. pnpm vitest run tests/acceptance/outfits-create.test.ts>

checks.description: <observable criterion, e.g. empty wardrobe screen shows one primary 'Add item' action and no placeholder text at 390x844, light and dark>
<observable criterion that needs the live environment, e.g. production canary purchase in sandbox mode completes and the webhook is recorded once>
checks.mechanism: <script or runbook path that performs the live check>

checks.description: <human decision or sign-off, e.g. owner approves the App Store listing copy>
